newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila c. bank says no changes in overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila c. bank says no changes in overnight rates.

text.p: Philippine central bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Friday there were no changes in overnight lending and borrowing rates.
Speaking at a news conference, Singson said there were substantial dollar inflows into the country.

The central bank has cut its benchmark overnight borrowing rate twice this week. The latest cut which became effective Friday took the rate down to 25 percent. Ahead of this week's reductions, the rate stood at 32 percent.
Singson said three banks had offered to raise funds for the central bank.
ING Bank offered to raise $500 million, J.P. Morgan offered to raise $1 billion to $2 billion and Chase Manhattan made an offer without specifying an amount, he said.
"We don't need it but it's nice to be offered because it shows you are still a good credit," Singson said.
